actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create a complete fresh color drawing preserving image 1's full BACK-view pose, body proportions, camera, clothing, both hands and both held fictional daggers. White background, clean Japanese hand-drawn anime linework and crisp cel color. Do not restage this already established back-view pose.

Make only these visible corrections while redrawing the whole image:
1. At the rear belt, REMOVE BOTH curved metal knife guards accidentally copied onto the empty mounts. Each mount is ONLY a compact BLACK LEATHER short open cradle: visibly hollow top opening, short front wall and side walls, a short opened retaining strap with its stud, and a closed belt-through loop at the back. No winged metal crossguard, blade, red collar, grip or pommel remains on either waist mount. The actual metal guards stay attached to the two daggers in her hands. Both rear supports are empty because both knives have been drawn. Use image 4 only for the leather cradle/belt-loop/strap relationship; ignore all knife components in that reference. Do not enlarge these into long sheaths or add side-waist boxes.
2. Restore the small actual white stylized OG emblem on the visible LEFT sleeve pocket, matching image 2's real graphic rather than typeset letters.

Image 1 is the back-view pose/layout and material reference, with the two listed defects not authoritative. Image 2 is current back identity and clothing; do not copy its standing pose. Image 3 is the exact dagger master: preserve dark broad angular blade/segmented grip/angular pommel on character RIGHT (screen RIGHT), ivory swept blade/curved guard/flowing grip/ivory teardrop pommel on LEFT (screen LEFT). Image 4 supplies only the empty leather mount parts described above.

Keep the raised right hand black full-finger including thumb, with red cuff; lower left hand fingerless with orange screen terminal. Both still genuinely close around the grips, guards outside hands. Same hair and rear goggle strap, no rear face, orange jacket's short back hem and white underlayer, bare lower back, red shorts/back pockets/pure belt, right thigh two modules/white sock, left orange stocking, red boots. Preserve clean head/hair, clothing and skin color shapes. No upper straps, chains, extra weapons, text or inset. Projected blade lengths may differ with camera angle; do not redesign their shapes or use projected ratios as a reason to restage them.
